subject: general
question: A tourist wanted to see the planetarium in a city. He walked from the railway station in the east direction and arrived at a pond. He turned left and then at the second corner of the pond, he turned right. Soon he reached another corner of the pond. He turned left and arrived at the planetarium. In what direction was the railway station situated with respect to the planetarium?
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/d72d0dd98232686e796e7ff34049c1ebcfea0d29d274a25317671f6c1395e86b.png]

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ff4c78682af0035d50fca4e7717ef433469e31273de0b2002cb34f6370904854.png] 

Hence, the railway station situated in **south-west **direction with respect to the planetarium.
